title: Data Types and Adapters
summary: This module provides a flexible framework for defining custom data types and adapters, enabling DSPy to seamlessly interact with Language Models and handle diverse structured and unstructured data formats.

nodes.label: Manage LM Interactions
nodes.title: Base Adapter Interface
nodes.description: Defines the foundational contract for DSPy to communicate with Language Models, handling prompt construction, response parsing, and integration of native LM features like function calling and citations. It ensures consistent interaction across different LMs.

nodes.label: Optimize Pydantic Schema
nodes.title: BAML Schema Adapter
nodes.description: Enhances the rendering of complex Pydantic models into a compact, human-readable schema for LMs. This improves token efficiency and comprehension for smaller models, incorporating Pydantic field descriptions as comments for context.

nodes.label: Extract Structured Data (Two-Step)
nodes.title: Two-Step Extraction Adapter
nodes.description: Implements a two-stage process: a primary LM generates a natural language response, and a secondary, smaller LM extracts structured data from that response. This is ideal for reasoning models that struggle with direct structured output.

nodes.label: Define Custom Data Structures
nodes.title: Base Custom Type System
nodes.description: Provides the abstract base for all DSPy custom data types, enabling structured data to be seamlessly integrated into signatures. It supports serialization, nested type extraction, and adaptation to native LM features.

nodes.label: Handle Audio Content
nodes.title: Audio Data Type
nodes.description: Represents audio data within DSPy, facilitating its inclusion in multimodal LM inputs. It supports various audio formats and handles encoding from URLs, local files, or raw arrays into base64 for LM consumption.

nodes.label: Manage Code Snippets
nodes.title: Code Data Type
nodes.description: Encapsulates programming code for tasks like code generation or analysis. It allows specifying the language and ensures proper formatting for LM processing, including markdown block representation for outputs.

nodes.label: Represent Citable Documents
nodes.title: Document Data Type
nodes.description: Models documents for use in citation-enabled LM interactions. It includes the document's text content, optional title, media type, and context, allowing LMs to reference source material accurately.

nodes.label: Integrate File Data
nodes.title: File Content Type
nodes.description: Manages file content for LM inputs, supporting data URIs, file IDs, or direct paths. It provides utilities to load files from local storage or web resources, encoding them appropriately for transmission to LMs.

nodes.label: Process Image Content
nodes.title: Image Data Type
nodes.description: Represents image data for multimodal LM inputs. It supports various sources like URLs, local files, raw bytes, or PIL images, converting them into base64 data URIs for efficient LM processing.

nodes.label: Define Callable Tools
nodes.title: Function Tool Type
nodes.description: Wraps Python functions to be used as callable tools by LLMs. It automatically infers function names, descriptions, and argument schemas, enabling robust function calling capabilities within DSPy programs.

nodes.label: Structure LM Citations
nodes.title: Citations Data Type
nodes.description: Manages structured citation information, including cited text, document indices, and character ranges. It provides methods to convert from dictionary lists and format for LM outputs, ensuring accurate source attribution.

nodes.label: Represent Tool Invocations
nodes.title: Tool Calls Data Type
nodes.description: Encapsulates a list of tool invocations, each with a tool name and its arguments. This type is crucial for parsing and representing structured function calls returned by Language Models.

nodes.label: Interact with LMs
nodes.title: Language Model Client
nodes.description: An external component that provides the programmatic interface for sending requests to and receiving responses from various Language Models, abstracting away specific API details.

nodes.label: Define LM Task Structure
nodes.title: DSPy Signature Definition
nodes.description: An external DSPy component that formally specifies the input and output fields, along with instructions, for a particular Language Model task, guiding the LM's behavior.

nodes.label: Validate Data Schemas
nodes.title: Pydantic Library
nodes.description: An external Python library widely used for data validation, parsing, and serialization, especially for defining data schemas with type hints.

nodes.label: Extract Structured Chat
nodes.title: Chat Adapter (External)
nodes.description: An external DSPy adapter, often used for general chat-based interactions, which the TwoStepAdapter leverages specifically for structured data extraction from raw LM responses.

nodes.label: Provide Program Inputs
nodes.title: User Input Data
nodes.description: The raw data or queries supplied by an end-user or another system, which serves as the initial input to a DSPy program.

nodes.label: Communicate with LLM
nodes.title: LLM API Endpoint
nodes.description: The actual external API endpoint of a Large Language Model, responsible for receiving formatted requests and returning raw or processed text responses.

nodes.label: Store Files Locally/Remotely
nodes.title: File Storage System
nodes.description: A system (local disk, cloud storage) used for persisting and retrieving files and other media content, accessed by DSPy's file-related data types.

nodes.label: Fetch Web Resources
nodes.title: Web Service/URL
nodes.description: Any external web-based service or URL that provides data (e.g., images, audio, documents) which DSPy's custom types can fetch and process.

nodes.label: Execute External Functions
nodes.title: Tool Execution Environment
nodes.description: The runtime environment or mechanism responsible for invoking and managing the execution of external functions or APIs defined as DSPy Tools.

groups.label: Adapter Core
groups.title: Core Adapter Functionality
groups.description: The foundational component for managing interactions between DSPy programs and Language Models.

groups.label: Specialized Adapters
groups.title: Specific LM Interaction Strategies
groups.description: Implementations of the base adapter that provide tailored strategies for interacting with LMs, such as optimizing schema rendering or employing multi-stage processing.

groups.label: Custom Type Base
groups.title: Foundation for Custom Data Types
groups.description: The abstract base class that all DSPy custom data types extend, providing common functionality for structured data handling within the framework.

groups.label: Media & File Types
groups.title: Handling Diverse Media and Files
groups.description: Custom data types designed to represent and process various forms of media (audio, images) and general file content for multimodal and file-aware LM interactions.

groups.label: Structured Content Types
groups.title: Representing Structured Information
groups.description: Custom data types for encapsulating structured information such as code snippets, citable documents, and parsed citations or tool calls from LM responses.

groups.label: Tooling Types
groups.title: Enabling Function Calling
groups.description: A specialized custom type that wraps Python functions, making them callable tools for Language Models to interact with external systems or perform specific operations.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External Systems and Libraries
groups.description: Components and systems outside this module that are integrated with or utilized by the data types and adapters, including Language Models, DSPy's core signature definitions, and data validation libraries.
